SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'ISDS') AND IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ, STATUS, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, GR_QTY, UNIT_PRICE, GR_AMT, GR_DATE FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_GR_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND GR_NO = '$G_RS.GR_NO$' AND GR_SEQ = '$G_RS.GR_SEQ$' AND STATUS = '$G_RS.STATUS$'
